newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Jardine forms furniture distribution firm.
newsitem.headline: Jardine forms furniture distribution firm.

text.p: Philippines' Jardine Davies Inc said on Monday it had formed a subsidiary which would engage in distribution of home furniture.

Corporate secretary B.S. Chungunco told the Securities and Exchange Commission that Jardine had a 65 percent stake in the company, while its local partner GPI International Export Corp will take the remaining 35 percent.
Jardine has interests in securities brokerage, life insurance, shipping, manufacturing and distribution of cement, refractories and timber.
